payload.question: Your email appeared in the LinkedIn breach (117M accounts). The breach exposed: email addresses, hashed passwords, and professional info. Which action should you prioritize FIRST?
options: Change your LinkedIn password and any other accounts using the same password
Delete your LinkedIn account to remove the exposed data
Change only your LinkedIn password since that's the only affected site
Wait to see if there's suspicious activity before taking action

explanation: Password reuse is the critical risk: if you used your LinkedIn password elsewhere (email, banking, work systems), attackers run credential stuffing attacks within hours of a breach being published. Change LinkedIn AND every account sharing that password immediately. Deleting the account doesn't undo the breach — the data is already in attacker databases.
